about: Ky's hand grades for 20 answers, the yardstick for every grader and prompt change (ROADMAP v1.1). For each answer, fill in taskMet (yes / partly / no) and list every mistake as { skill, quote }. Skill ids are in src/core/skills.ts. Answers are written the way phone dictation delivers them: little punctuation, no capital letters.
